def min_instability(n, arr):
    # Sort the array to easily find the minimum and maximum after removing one element
    arr.sort()
    
    # Calculate the initial instability
    initial_instability = arr[-1] - arr[0]
    
    # Try removing each element and calculate the new instability
    min_instability = float('inf')
    for i in range(n):
        # Calculate the new minimum and maximum after removing arr[i]
        new_min = min(arr[0:i], arr[i+1:n])
        new_max = max(arr[0:i], arr[i+1:n])
        # Update the minimum instability found so far
        min_instability = min(min_instability, new_max - new_min)
    
    return min_instability
